notes.title: 50% Off!
notes.notes:
Prepare to be captivated by the allure of "Who Made This Art? Human or AI?" as we offer an unprecedented 50% discount during our special event. Delve into the world of digital artistry and embark on a quest to decipher the origins of captivating creations. With each meticulously crafted piece, you'll find yourself questioning the boundaries of human and artificial intelligence.

Whether you're a solo explorer or prefer the interactive engagement of Twitch chat, this event promises an immersive experience for all. Engage in spirited debates, share your insights, and compete with fellow art enthusiasts as you strive to prove your mastery in distinguishing between human and AI creativity.
